laws.rule: Sky lanterns (khom loi) at Loi Krathong: for the 2023 festival a Chiang Rai provincial announcement limited releases near Mae Fah Luang-Chiang Rai International Airport to set windows on 26 to 28 November (10:00 to 12:00 and 21:00 to 01:00 Thai time) and limited lantern size to 90 cm across, 140 cm high, 1 cubic metre in volume and 8 minutes of burning. The province issues a new announcement each year.
laws.heading: AIP Supplement A 45/23, relaying the Chiang Rai provincial announcement

sources.title: SUP 45/23 Warning of sky lantern activity in the vicinity of Mae Fah Luang-Chiang Rai International Airport (VTCT)
